identity.title: External Historical Research Bridge
identity.objective: Create the smallest truthful, local/offline provenance bridge from already-validated PMXT v2 external history into the merged WP170 experiment OS: a bounded, deterministic, content-addressed PmxtV2ResearchLineage over explicitly selected existing WP168 event digests, an ExternalDatasetBinding that carries real source availability time without acquiring canonical-PIT authority, and a standard WP170 ResearchDatasetManifest whose external samples cite only bound external member IDs; it grants no strategy, OOS, WP172, paper, downloader, credential, network, execution, or live authority.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: The user explicitly transmitted and instructed execution of the attached WP175D one-shot package, which fixes the exact changed-file scope at 24 files (max_changed_files 24) and repeatedly forbids a 25th path; 24 exceeds the L budget of 20, so the package is XL for scope size only with a hard maximum of 24 files and no broadened authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175D. Only the additive PMXT v2 research-lineage surface, the ExternalDatasetBinding subtype and its bridge, the registry DATASET_BINDING schema_id dispatch, focused tests, the external-historical-research-bridge contract, and package/status/repo-truth documentation are removed. WP167 PMXT validation, WP168 ConvertedEventStream identity, WP170 canonical DatasetBinding behavior, the registry schema/version/application id, and all merged canonical registry bytes are read and referenced but never rewritten; no dependency, workflow, network, credential, downloader, strategy, paper, execution, or live state is created.
